summary: Tested new Related Articles carousel (RelatedArticlesCarousel.jsx) on BlogPost.jsx across 4 blog posts in different categories (Managed IT, Cybersecurity, AI & Automation, Compliance). Carousel renders correctly with data-testid='blog-related-articles', heading dynamically shows 'More on {Category}', first N cards are same-category as current post before other categories appear, prev/next arrows work without errors, clicking a related article card navigates correctly and URL changes. Mobile viewport (390px) shows ~1 card per view (basis-full). Old static 3-column grid with broken 'border-white/10/50' class is fully removed - code review confirms no leftover styling. Regression check: blog post title, content, CTA button, and Related Resources links block all render correctly - no breakage from relatedPosts->allPosts rename.
critical_code_review_comments: RelatedArticlesCarousel.jsx is clean, well-scoped (51 lines), correctly filters by category then falls back to other categories, slices to 8 - matches requirements exactly.
No leftover 'border-white/10/50' invalid Tailwind class found anywhere in BlogPost.jsx or the new component.
CarouselPrevious/Next use 'hidden sm:flex' so arrows are hidden on mobile - acceptable since mobile users can swipe, but worth noting no visible nav control on mobile viewport (minor, by design).
